systems.name: Radhiant Admin Portal
systems.purpose: Day-to-day RDISA operations: dashboard, patients, individual and corporate calendars, truck trip approval, appointment/performance/NPS reports, patient forms, tickets, staff management, and the Company Dashboard (weekly scorecard, quarterly goals, to-dos, headlines).

systems.name: Investor Vault
systems.purpose: NDA-gated investor data room with watermarked documents, 2FA and download audit logs. Papermark vault also runs at investors.rdisa.co.za.

systems.name: Patient Outreach
systems.purpose: Mammogram recall and patient re-engagement over SMS, WhatsApp and email, with POPIA opt-out tracking. Runs under the RDISA recall POPIA carve-out.

systems.name: HubSpot CRM
systems.purpose: Sales CRM with the 12-stage pipeline. Linked from the Admin Portal CRM menu item.

systems.name: Microsoft 365
systems.purpose: Email (Outlook), calendars, SharePoint Working Folders (Company-Wide, Finance, Marketing and Sales, Operations, CEO-Office), Planner for tasks.

systems.name: Plaud
systems.purpose: Meeting transcription for L10s, Leadership Meetings and reviews.

systems.name: Radhiant Hub
systems.purpose: Internal operations and intelligence platform (v2.6.0). Pre-production.

systems.name: RIS-PACS
systems.purpose: Multi-tenant radiology information system, imaging archive (Orthanc/OHIF), billing and medical-aid switch. Pre-staging; about 30 to 50 hours of engineering from production-ready.

systems.name: Radhiant CDS
systems.purpose: Clinical decision support for diagnostic imaging referrals.

systems.name: Radhiant Life
systems.purpose: Executive health and performance platform with wearable sync.

systems.name: Radhiant Brain
systems.purpose: This app, plus the governed company memory layer behind it (spec V0.6, 28 June 2026): registers, source lanes, POPIA gates and portal exports.
